words.enExample: Take a pause between tasks to let your mind settle.
words.zhExample: 在两件事之间暂停一下，让思绪沉淀。
words.note: 源自古法语，原指“休止、停顿”。作名词/动词皆可：a brief pause / pause to think。近义：break / halt；反义：continue。

words.enExample: Learn to appreciate the small, quiet moments.
words.zhExample: 学会欣赏那些微小而安静的时刻。
words.note: ap-（朝向）+ preti（价值）→ 看清其价值。两义：①欣赏（事物之美）②感激（他人之恩）。名词 appreciation。近义：value / treasure。

words.enExample: This moment is the only one you truly have.
words.zhExample: 这一刻，才是你真正拥有的。
words.note: 来自拉丁 momentum（运动、片刻）。live in the moment = 活在当下。复数为 moments。近义：instant / minute。

words.enExample: An unhurried morning sets a calm tone for the day.
words.zhExample: 一个从容的早晨，定下整天的平和基调。
words.note: un-（不）+ hurried（匆忙的）→ 不慌张的。由 hurry 加否定前缀构成，描述从容节奏。近义：relaxed / leisurely；反义：rushed。

words.enExample: Let your mind wander without judging it.
words.zhExample: 让思绪随意飘荡，不去评判它。
words.note: 源自古英语，表“漫游、游荡”。wander 与 wonder（想知道）拼写易混。也可指走神：mind wanders。近义：roam / drift。

essay.title: The Quiet Gift of Time
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: We treat time as something to defeat—to save, to hack, to squeeze into smaller boxes. But time is not an enemy to outrun. It is the medium in which a life actually happens, and the only resource that, once spent, is gone for good.

A slower day is not a wasted day. To pause and watch light move across a wall, to really taste a meal, to listen without planning your reply—these are not luxuries. They are the texture of being alive, and they cost nothing but attention.
So give time the respect it deserves. Protect a few unhurried hours. Let your mind wander now and then. The urgent will always return; the quiet moment, once missed, will not.
translations: 我们把时间当成要击败的东西——要节省、要优化、要塞进更小的格子。但时间不是要甩开的敌人。它是一段生命真实发生的介质，也是唯一一种一旦花掉就永不回来的资源。
慢下来的一天，不是被浪费的一天。停下脚步看光在墙上移动，认真尝一口饭，不带盘算地去倾听——这些都不是奢侈。它们正是"活着"的质感，除了注意力，分文不取。
所以，请给予时间它应得的尊重。守护几个不被催促的小时。偶尔让思绪飘荡。紧急的事总会回来；而那安静的一刻，一旦错过，便不再来。

grammar.example: "It is the medium in which a life actually happens, and the only resource that, once spent, is gone for good."
"To pause and watch light move across a wall, to really taste a meal, to listen without planning your reply—these are not luxuries."

vocab.enExample: We treat time as something to defeat.
vocab.zhExample: 我们把时间当成某种需要战胜的东西。
vocab.note: 名词 defeat 意为「失败」（a heavy defeat）。原文用 defeat time 讽刺效率至上的心态。近义 beat / conquer；反义 surrender to。

vocab.enExample: We try to squeeze life into smaller boxes.
vocab.zhExample: 我们试图把生活塞进更小的盒子里。
vocab.note: squeeze sth. into sth. 为高频搭配。名词 squeeze 可指「紧缩」，如 credit squeeze。近义 compress / cram；反义 expand。

vocab.enExample: Time is not an enemy to outrun.
vocab.zhExample: 时间不是可以甩在身后的敌人。
vocab.note: out-（超过）+ run。同类构词：outperform（表现优于）、outgrow（长得超过）。近义 outpace / outstrip；反义 lag behind。

vocab.enExample: It is the medium in which a life actually happens.
vocab.zhExample: 它是生命真正得以展开的媒介。
vocab.note: 复数 media / mediums。也指「传媒」（social media）与「中等的」（medium size）。近义 vehicle / channel。

vocab.enExample: It is the only resource that, once spent, is gone for good.
vocab.zhExample: 它是唯一一种一旦花掉就永远消失的资源。
vocab.note: 此处 good 作名词，意为「益处」，for good = 定局。近义 permanently / once and for all；反义 temporarily。

vocab.enExample: These are the texture of being alive.
vocab.note: 本义指布料、食物的触感，引申为「生活的质地」。近义 grain / feel。反义 smoothness 仅在物理语境下成立。

vocab.zhExample: 为自己守住几个从容的小时。
vocab.note: un- + hurried。副词 unhurriedly。近义 leisurely / relaxed；反义 rushed / frantic / hectic。

vocab.enExample: Let your mind wander now and then.
vocab.zhExample: 时不时让你的思绪散散步。
vocab.note: mind wanders = 走神；wander off = 偏离。比 walk 更强调「无固定方向」。近义 drift / roam；反义 focus / concentrate。
